ready.materialThesis: investment cast stainless steel with bead-blasted/sandblasted satin finish, mirror polished stainless steel ball, machined stainless details, graphite/dark seals, PTFE/light soft-seat visual treatment

supplierTerms.ball: 不锈钢高亮度抛光球体 / mirror polished stainless steel ball
supplierTerms.machined: 机加工不锈钢零件 / machined stainless steel
supplierTerms.graphite: 石墨填料或黑色密封圈 / graphite packing or dark sealing ring
supplierTerms.ptfe: PTFE 或浅色软密封视觉 / PTFE or light soft seat visual treatment

ballIsolation.invariant: Only the true ball core receives ballTurn; valve seats and seat seals remain fixed soft-seal material groups.

states.name: 完整产品材质平衡
states.purpose: 确认喷砂铸造阀体、机加工件、紧固件和暗色密封的整体层级。

states.name: 正面爆炸首帧候选
states.purpose: 验证未来滚动首帧的完整爆炸构图，避免从合体状态开始。

states.name: 高亮抛光球体近景
states.purpose: 确认球体是高亮抛光不锈钢，反射更柔和，黑白硬块减少。

states.name: 喷砂铸造阀体/法兰近景
states.purpose: 确认阀体/阀盖从白亮银改为不锈钢硅溶胶铸造喷砂表面。

states.name: 紧固件/密封圈细节
states.purpose: 确认紧固件、黑色密封/石墨填料与浅色 PTFE 视觉分层。

constraints: Goal 19 renders exactly five 4K Three.js material lookdev stills.
Goal 19 adapts the Goal 16 assembled, exploded, ball-open, and ball-closed reusable animation states.
The homepage is not replaced or connected to these stills.

Supplier terms guide visual material families only: investment cast bead-blasted stainless shell, mirror polished stainless ball, machined stainless, graphite/dark seals, and PTFE/light soft-seat treatment.
Only the true ball core receives ballTurn; valve seats and seal groups remain fixed.
No pressure, flow-rate, zero-leakage, fire-safe, anti-static, DBB/DIB, certified material grade, or medium claim is made.
